title: Do Cold Email Laws Apply to LinkedIn Messages? Read the Definitions
meta_description: Read on 26 September 2026: four anti-spam regimes define the covered message by where it lands or how it is stored, which reaches a LinkedIn DM, and two US courts have read CAN-SPAM the same way.
primary_keyword: do cold email laws apply to linkedin messages

image.takeaway: Four regimes define the regulated message by where it lands, not by whether it is email.
image.alt: Do cold email laws apply to LinkedIn messages? Four regimes define the message by where it lands
